subject: general
question: Four persons A, B, C and D are playing carrom. A is to the immediate left of C. D is to the immediate right of B. Which statement shows the correct position of A?
solution:
Four persons A, B, C and D are playing carrom.

A is to the immediate left of C and D is to the immediate right of B.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a52befbac80a45613ca1f260d80b33c1795da5c8761bb80871062100f59f0e4c.png] 

∴ Here, the position of A is opposite of B.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Opposite B".**
